product_one_liner.value: interface.ai provides agentic voice, chat and employee-assistance AI that automates customer service and banking transactions for credit unions and community banks.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage identifies credit unions and community banks as its audience and describes transaction-completing AI plus customer-facing chat and employee assistance: https://interface.ai/.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation has no pricing link, and the reviewed pricing URL did not expose plans or prices. A current independent review also explicitly reports no pricing page: https://interface.ai/ and https://www.getmacha.com/blog/interface-ai-complete-guide.

founded_year.notes: The company profile explicitly lists 2019 as its founding year: https://linkedin.com/company/interface-ai.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents business-oriented AI insights for financial-institution leaders, not an engineering publication: https://interface.ai/blog. Inspection of its retrieval and compliance articles did not establish two engineer-authored accounts of how the product is built; both are product/solution overviews by Jack Chawla: https://interface.ai/blog/why-multi-granular-retrieval-future-member-service and https://interface.ai/blog/trust-gap-compliance-firewall-safe-financial-ai.

public_docs.notes: No public product-documentation, developer-portal or help-center link was found in the homepage navigation/footer: https://interface.ai/. The Knowledge Center is a collection of marketing ebooks, guides and tools, not product documentation: https://interface.ai/knowledge-center. Checks of the docs and help subdomains did not yield readable documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists Applied AI Engineer, Business Automation, with a corresponding public posting: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/interface-ai/c4d8b111-8084-4e02-86d5-c28591439612.

model_provider.notes: No specific product AI model or model provider was established. The platform refers generically to multiple LLMs, the blog describes specialized fine-tuned models, and the public subprocessor list names infrastructure vendors without identifying the models powering the product: https://interface.ai/platform, https://interface.ai/blog/trust-gap-compliance-firewall-safe-financial-ai and https://trust.interface.ai/. Employee access to Claude is not evidence that the customer-facing product uses Claude.
